title: Seeking a Heart Free of Hatred
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ كَرَاهِيَةً لِأَحَدٍ
transliteration: Allāhumma lā tajʿal fī qalbī karāhiyatan li'aḥad
translation: Oh Allah, don't let the hate of anyone reside in my heart.
reference: A personal supplication for maintaining a pure heart
